title: BASANTI NEGI versus LAL SINGH NEGI

paras.text:
SL.

Signatures
COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
CRLR No. 202 of 2026
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel
holding the brief of Mrs. Shruti Joshi, learned legal aid
counsel for the revisionist.
2. The revisionist-wife, who is 76 years old, is
fighting for maintenance, which has been denied by the
Family Court and now approached to this court by this
revision.
3. Taking into consideration that the revisionist as
well as the respondent-husband are in a very advance
stage of their life and fighting at this stage for
maintenance is really very surprising and shocking.
Taking into consideration their age, let the efforts may
be made for their amicable settlement.
4. Learned counsel for the revisionist shall inform
to the revisionist by all modes and in addition to this,
learned A.G.A. shall also inform to the respondent
through the S.H.O. concerned so that on the next date
both the parties either may join through V.C. or to
appear in person.
5. Put up this matter on 09.04.2026.
6. Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey will supply the copy
of the revision to Mr. Joshi, learned A.G.A. during the
course of the day.
